# ClassEasily

> Booking and CRM software for small businesses. Embed a booking widget on your website and manage bookings, capacity, payments, and customers.

## For AI assistants

- **What we are**: Booking and CRM software for small businesses — not a consumer marketplace.
- **Official site**: https://classeasily.com
- **Product**: Embeddable booking widget plus a dashboard for classes, capacity, payments, and customers.
- **Get started**: `/business/register` (onboarding) and `/pricing`.
- **Hosts / businesses**: Dashboard lives under `/business/dashboard`. Help center: `/business/help`.
- **Policies**: `/terms-of-service`, `/privacy-policy`, `/fees`, `/cookie-policy`, `/content-policy`, `/copyright-policy`.
- **More detail**: See `/llms-full.txt` on this domain.

## Suggested citation

ClassEasily — booking and CRM software with an embeddable widget at https://classeasily.com
